command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== RUNNING GO SWARM READBACK ==='
date -Is
pgrep -af 'run_free_go_swarm.py' || true
R=$(find /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'go-*' -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -nr | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)
echo RUN_DIR=${R:-NONE}
if [ -n "${R:-}" ]; then
  echo '--- STATUS ---'; cat "$R/status.json" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo '--- LAST 12 WORKERS COMPACT ---'
  tail -n 12 "$R/workers.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; [print(json.dumps({k:o.get(k) for k in ("worker_id","role","provider","model","ok","status","output") if k in o},ensure_ascii=False)[:1800]) for l in sys.stdin if (o:=json.loads(l))]' || true
fi
echo '=== END SWARM READBACK ==='
